exception.justification: Justified: Process selection precedes observation installation and cannot record itself.

review.body: { if let Some (policy) = PROCESS_POLICY . get () { return Ok (* policy) ; } let disable = std :: env :: var_os ("PN_OBSERVE_DISABLE") ; let level = std :: env :: var_os ("PN_OBSERVE_LEVEL") ; let selected = EmissionPolicy :: select (disable . as_deref () , level . as_deref () , BuildKind :: compiled ()) ? ; let _installed = PROCESS_POLICY . set (selected) ; Ok (PROCESS_POLICY . get () . copied () . unwrap_or (selected)) }
review.item_premise: This pre-installation policy helper reads public mode inputs or immutable kind state without a private carrier or independent delivery; its terminal diagnostic belongs to the shared command boundary.
